provenance: Mocked vision-model reply, written by the T68 build (no model was called). Scene cuts and the text in each scene follow the recorded EasyOCR cache in research/claim-level/dataset/transcripts/<id>.json (on_screen.detections); card and subtitle text is that text with obvious EasyOCR misreads corrected, as a vision model would read it. A document's 'text' is what a pre-T68 reply would have copied (the EasyOCR text of that scene) and exists only for the before/after comparison: the T68 parser never keeps it. Kinds were assigned by hand following vision_ocr.SYSTEM; whether a real model assigns the same kinds is what the proposed (g) comparison would measure.
